verdict.rationale: Close's developer docs reference a first-party integrations directory where OAuth partner apps get listed. That implies a marketplace of prebuilt integrations exists, but the evidence describes it only from the developer-listing side. The data-warehouse mention is about building with the API, not installing a prebuilt connector, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documentation of ops users browsing and installing apps from the directory, evidence of specific prebuilt Slack/support desk/marketing/data warehouse integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: Build for many Close customers with OAuth and get listed in the integrations directory.
